title: A fixture re-record drops other rows' approval blocks and stamps one reason on every gated row
foundBy: session agent, re-recording CF-05 for SAC-097
details: `make fixtures FIXTURE_ARGS="--update --approve <id> --reason <sentence>"` rewrites every row the run measures, in `dispatch-viewer/fixtures/run.mjs`. A measured row whose value is unchanged loses its `approval` or `origin` block, so re-recording one row deletes the permission slips of others. Every row whose value changed gets the one `--reason`, even when it changed for another cause. Re-recording CF-05 this way dropped five earlier blocks. It also gave the size rows CF-40 and CF-41 a reason about the legend, though they drifted because the page grew. Their checks pass on the size budget alone. A re-record that kept unchanged rows verbatim, and could name the rows it may change, would let a diff carry only the change it approves.
